I've attached the onboarding form and a sample invoice template to make formatting straightforward. If you prefer, we can accept scanned PDFs.

Hi Claire / Rishi — thanks for the form and certificate, that should be sufficient for vendor creation. A couple internal process notes and requests: 

- Vendor record creation: Procurement will create the vendor record in NetPay once we receive the completed form + VAT docs (we have both).
- PO requirements: please include the PO number on line 1 of the invoice and the remit-to details (bank wiring instructions) in the body — our AP team validates these before payment.
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net 45 for new vendors by default; however, we can honor Net 30 for established partners. If Nordica wants Net 30 please confirm and we'll set payment terms accordingly in the vendor record.
- Reverse-charge: Procurement flags the vendor record with VAT number and a note that invoices should be processed as "reverse charge" where applicable. That will prevent VAT being charged by our systems.

Action items for Nordica: please confirm Net 30 vs Net 45 and paste the bank details you intend to use in the invoice (IBAN/BIC). If you prefer, you can add those fields to the returned invoice template.

Rishi — once Claire confirms terms, I'll create the vendor and issue the PO (target within 2–3 business days).
